config.arms: Three trained endpoint-difference encoders; three direct-change encoders using transferred trained importance; three direct-change encoders with zero importance; dense128perport change reference.
config.direct: Compute delta=donor-recipient, coefficients=(delta/scale)@B, select using squared delta coefficients, decode once with no center. Add decoded delta to native recipient.
config.budget: Direct max16perport/48total; endpoint encoders max16perendpoint/port but difference union can be32perport/96total. Dense128perport/384total is capacity reference.
config.limits: Paired edit operator receives both endpoints. Not autonomous state reconstruction, nor new-task discovery. Trained importance was optimized for endpoints, not direct changes. Fixed random group memberships; no causal output used for support.
config.evaluation: Same opened H1042/H1043 panels. No selection or fitting on them.
